title: FLUX.2 Pro
description: Edit a photo with a text instruction or combine up to 8 reference images into one new picture. Try FLUX.2 Pro by Black Forest Labs on Wiro now.
pricing: $0.03 per run for an output image up to 1024 x 1024 pixels, plus $0.015 per further 1024 x 1024 block, plus $0.015 per 1024 x 1024 block of each input image (at most 4 blocks per image). Pixels are counted in blocks of 1024 x 1024 (1,048,576 pixels), and part of a block counts as a whole one: 1000 x 1050 is 2 blocks. Only the first output image is measured.

items.label: Prompt
items.sample: Place the car in the image 2 to the road on the image 1.

items.label: Width
items.note: Width in pixels (must be multiple of 16). Set it to 0 or do not send if you want to match input image. Flux accepts between 64 and 2048.

items.label: Height
items.note: Height in pixels (must be multiple of 16). Set it to 0 or do not send if you want to match input image. Flux accepts between 64 and 2048.

items.label: Safety Tolerance
items.note: Tolerance level for input and output moderation. Between 0 and 5, 0 being most strict, 5 being least strict.

items.label: Seed
items.note: Seed for reproducible results. Use the same seed to get consistent outputs.

items.label: Output Format
items.note: Output format for the generated image.
